properties.displayName: UAV S67 - Container Registry Image Tampering
properties.description: 컨테이너 레지스트리에 푸시된 이미지의 Digest가 기대값(ImageDigestExpected)과 실제값(ImageDigestActual)이 불일치하거나, Approved_Operators_List에 없는 비인가 계정(PushedBy)의 푸시를 탐지. 공급망 무결성 훼손(이미지 변조/스푸핑) 징후. MITRE: T1195.002
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let ApprovedOps = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Operators_List') | project OperatorId;
UAVSupplyChain_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where EventType == 'RegistryPush'
| extend isDigestMismatch = (ImageDigestExpected != ImageDigestActual)
| extend isUnknownPusher = PushedBy !in (ApprovedOps)
| where isDigestMismatch or isUnknownPusher
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isDigestMismatch and isUnknownPusher, strcat("레지스트리_다이제스트불일치_비인가푸시_", PushedBy),
    isDigestMismatch, strcat("레지스트리_다이제스트불일치_", Registry),
    strcat("레지스트리_비인가_푸시자_", PushedBy))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, Registry, PushedBy, ImageDigestExpected, ImageDigestActual, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S67 - Container Registry Image Tampering - {{Registry}}
